inputs.database_catalog_note: No dmv database exists in the active PostgreSQL 16.14 cluster; no database was created for this audit.

dataset.row_count_method: newline count minus one header row; no database scan
dataset.distinct_cardinality_note: Unavailable without a catalog or an additional full CSV profile; intentionally not computed.
dataset.setup_behavior: CREATE TABLE, COPY CSV, btrim categorical columns, ANALYZE; server defaults inherited
dataset.statistics_target_note: init_dmv.sh does not SET a target; the absent database prevents verifying the inherited server value.

workload.truth_encoding: exactly one trailing ||integer per non-empty line

candidate_universe.rule: one unordered pair for every pair of distinct predicate columns co-occurring in a query

semantic_coverage.boundary: PostgreSQL 16.14 base-restriction MCV+FD; AND; scalar equality MCV; equality/IN FD applicability; fixed precedence

fd_relevance.applicability_rule: equality-to-pseudoconstant and IN/ANY columns, as validated by FD-Semantics-v0

census.dominant_forms: numeric scalar equality and closed ranges

census_comparison.interpretation: DMV is larger in queries but has a tiny dense 36-pair categorical universe; Census has a large sparse 2,253-pair numeric universe. DMV adds a high-reuse IN-heavy regime.

replication_feasibility.reason: load existing CSV/create absent DMV database and adapt query plumbing
same pair construction and PostgreSQL payload extraction; text payloads
1,913 queries require executable MCV IN/ScalarArray semantics
search is reusable but objective coverage depends on MCV IN replay
same isolated deployment pattern; DMV table/name/order plumbing
same PostgreSQL operation once database is loaded
requires MCV IN/ScalarArray replay before native comparison

decision.reason: DMV is structurally meaningful and 98.02% multivariate, but 97.35% of queries contain IN and current executable MCV replay lacks ScalarArray/IN clause semantics.
